parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the toilet is a flat, hinged cover made of polypropylene plastic, designed to close over the seat.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to cover the toilet bowl when not in use, providing hygiene and aesthetic purposes.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate upward and downward around a hinge axis at the back.

parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: The seat is a ring-shaped component made of urea-formaldehyde plastic, providing a comfortable sitting surface.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user while sitting and provides a hygienic interface between the user and the toilet bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate upward and downward around the hinge, similar to the lid.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main structural part of the toilet made of vitreous china ceramic, forming the bowl and support structure.
parts.Functional_description: It holds water, supports the seat and lid, and connects to the plumbing system for flushing and drainage.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving component anchored to the wall or floor.
